objects.name: USTUDIO_CHARACTER_ROOT
objects.fixed_or_moving: moving; parented to USTUDIO_BOX_FLOAT_ROOT except exterior seated scene pose

objects.name: USTUDIO_INTERFACE_BRIDGE
objects.semantic_role: visible horizontal support and interface membrane
support_surfaces: four visible luminous anchors to piano-roll ramp

joints.limits: anatomical silhouette range; no hyperextension or limb inversion

supports_and_contacts.rule: both feet or declared hand/foot contacts remain on top plane z=1.94 local
pelvis rests on frame top; legs remain outside shell with positive clearance

camera_corridor.description: Interior cameras stay inside the open-front prism and above the bridge; exterior pause camera remains in front of y=-20 to -8; spiral is a non-circular 3D path with clearance checks every 45 degrees and a measured rear maximum y=1.28 against wall y=1.36.

shot_states.name: S1_AWAKENING
shot_states.object_state: standing centered on bridge, head rises and turns
shot_states.camera_state: 18 mm worm eye push-in and tilt-up

shot_states.name: S2_PAUSE
shot_states.object_state: seated on lower frame, feet pend outside, right foot taps
shot_states.camera_state: 35 to 55 mm macro foot to symmetric exterior reveal

shot_states.name: S3_RUN
shot_states.object_state: runs along bridge, reacts at 251, settles and resumes
shot_states.camera_state: 50 mm frontal retreat with bounded deterministic shake

shot_states.name: S4_COMMUNION
shot_states.camera_state: 35 to 85 mm descending 360 degree spiral with tested clearance

shot_states.name: FINAL_HOLD
shot_states.camera_state: recovery complete, no float or wobble
